train_summary.json.model_td_weight_reduction: Mean of weight times elementwise Huber; no sum-of-weights division
train_summary.json.confidence_definition: Frozen native trust: tau starts1e-3 and is updated by EMA0.9tau+0.1median(error) with median floor1e-8; c=1/(1+error/tau). QDelta uses normalized Bellman target(1-gamma_delta)*log(c)+gamma_delta*(1-done)*QDelta(next), gamma_delta0.9; native weight exponentiates learned log confidence. This is distinct from passenger critic gamma1 and per-batch sum-to-one or mean-matched weights.
train_summary.json.comparison_boundary: Matched comparison against existing real75k changes only critic mixed_backup_lambda0.1->1.0. Stage55k reference differs in training duration and actor/scheduling recipe; V-only here does not mean reverting the entire IQL training recipe.
train_summary.json.interpretation: One-variable continuation-backup diagnostic on already analyzed Halifax72571-72573 cases. Only V-only vs existing real75k isolates the mixed-backup change. Keep all seeds and days; no prospective/population claim or confidence-module attribution.
